name: Argus v4 hooked line
description: ABIs and addresses for launching on Portal #8 (launchPortal, portal8) and for reading every Argus launch on Arc. Generated from compiled artifacts: contracts-ark/tools/abi-bundle.mjs writes the version 3 base and scripts/argus-v4-portal8.mjs in the arguspad repo adds version 4 on top. Run the second after the first. Each re-reads its addresses from chain in a verify pass.
launchPortalNote: Portal #8. Every new launch goes here: portal8 has its addresses, ABIs, the launch call and its rules. Every other Portal in this file is LEGACY. Keep reading, trading and claiming its tokens with the entries below, but do not launch on it.
addressesNote: addresses and portalDeployBlock describe Portal #6 and stay as they were so readers of version 3 keep working. Do not launch on addresses.portal. Portal #8's addresses are portal8.addresses.

chain.name: Arc mainnet
notes: USDC is the gas token AND the default quote asset. The native 18dp balance and the 0x3600 ERC-20 view at 6dp are one balance, exactly 1e12 apart.
JSON-RPC batching is refused (-32600). viem batches by default; pass {batch: false}.
eth_getLogs caps at 10,000 blocks per request and 20,000 results per response, refusing the whole query either way.
Arc mines ~170,000 blocks a day. Every log carries blockTimestamp, so no per-block fetch is needed.
Native USDC transfers emit Transfer from the EIP-7708 pseudo-address 0xffff...fffe, not from 0x3600. Indexing only 0x3600 misses roughly 60% of movements.

portals.note: LEGACY. Do not launch here: every new launch goes to Portal #8, launchPortal. Tokens already launched here keep working on chain. The eleventh word of launches(token), index 10, is the quote asset that launch trades against, chosen per launch from the quotes the admin has approved (every launch so far uses 0x3600 USDC). launch() is not payable: the dev buy is pulled as an ERC-20 after an approve. The admin, a 2-of-3 Safe, approves and revokes quotes INSTANTLY and changes hookStore, splitterImpl and lockerImpl behind a four hour timelock, all for FUTURE launches only. tokenImpl, treasury, treasuryBps and devBuyMaxBps are immutable. Its reward registry is a new LaunchConfig, addresses.launchConfig.

Ten words, every launch against 0x3600 USDC, and launch() is payable: the dev buy is msg.value. The same admin and timelocked pointers as #6, without the quote list. Its reward registry is 0x71555a0674529a2bf7288193047aa1e06d267157, not addresses.launchConfig. Creator payouts are credited and delivered by claim(address) as on #6, but as a NATIVE USDC send, which Arc logs from the EIP-7708 pseudo-address rather than from 0x3600.

discriminator.answers10OnNote: Kept a single address for v1 readers. answers10OnAll lists every Portal that answers 10.
discriminator.onOlderPortals: Reverts. Depending on the endpoint a missing selector comes back as an execution-reverted error or as 0x with trace[0].error == 'Reverted'. Treat either as 'no usable answer' and pick the decoder from the Portal address.

decoding.portal8Note: Portal #8 decodes differently and fails both discriminators here: portal8.decoding.
decoding.quoteWord: On Portal #6 a launch's quote asset is index 10, the eleventh and last word of its record, not a constant. Build the pool key, the price and the decimals from it. Every launch on a ten- or nine-word Portal is against 0x3600 USDC.
decoding.bondedIsNotInTheStruct: bonded() lives on the HOOK, which is word 4. Also bondTick() and bondBound(). The hook latches the flag inside afterSwap, in the same transaction as the swap that crosses tickBond. There is no bond() and no bondable() anywhere on this line.
decoding.poolId: keccak256(abi.encode(currency0, currency1, fee, tickSpacing, hooks)), the currencies being the token and THAT LAUNCH'S quote (index 10 on #6, 0x3600 before it) in address order. THE HOOK IS PART OF THE KEY; omitting it yields a different, empty pool id. Every Argus v4 launch uses fee 10000 and tickSpacing 200. Prefer reading it from TokenCreated.poolId or hook.poolId() over rebuilding the key.

swapLogs.emitter: Swap is emitted by the PoolManager singleton, so the pool id in topic 1 is the only thing separating your token's trades from every other v4 trade on Arc. Filtering by address alone returns the whole chain. The data is SIX words: v3's five plus a trailing uint24 fee. Amounts are int128 but sign-extended across the full word, so a v3 decoder reads them correctly after truncating to five words.
swapLogs.signConvention: 🔴 v4 SIGNS ITS AMOUNTS FROM THE SWAPPER'S SIDE, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF UNISWAP v3. On v3 a negative leg is the amount that LEFT the pool. On v4 a negative leg is what the SWAPPER PAID. So a buy of the token is `tokenAmount < 0` on v3 and `tokenAmount > 0` on v4, and a decoder shared between the two labels every trade backwards on one of them. Nothing throws and nothing looks wrong: the magnitudes are identical either way and only the side flips.
swapLogs.signConventionEvidence: Measured on Arc mainnet, not read off a doc. sqrtPriceX96 is emitted INSIDE the swap log, so the direction the pool moved is knowable from the logs alone with no opinion about which token is which, and liquidity changes do not move it. Correlating sign(amount0) against that direction across consecutive swaps in one pool: v4, 48 pairs over 13 pools, 48 swapper / 0 pool. v3, 217 pairs over 67 pools, 0 swapper / 217 pool. Unanimous both ways.
swapLogs.sideRule: isBuy = tokenLeg > 0 on v4. Take magnitudes with abs() for size and volume: those are identical under either convention, which is why a volume figure can look perfectly correct while every side is inverted.
swapLogs.quoteLegUnits: The quote leg is in that launch's quote's own decimals, 6 for USDC. Read decimals() off the quote at index 10 rather than assuming 6.

legacyTokenCreated.note: The legacy line's TokenCreated is a DIFFERENT event with a different body: its fifth field is `address pool`, not `bytes32 poolId`. Decoding a legacy log against the hooked parameter list does not throw; it returns whichever strings happen to line up. Match on topic0. Every hooked Portal, #6 included, emits the SAME hooked event: #6 declares the same nine inputs as #5, and this topic0 is present in both runtimes.

decoding.allocationIsSharesOfTheStream: creatorBps / burnBps / dividendBps / liquidityBps are proportions OF THE COLLECTED STREAM, not of a trade. A launch at creatorBps 10000 with a 1% tax sends the creator all of that 1%, which is 'Creator 100%' and not 'Creator 1%'. Multiplying the shares back out by the tax rate produces numbers that look like small independent fees.

quote.legacyNote: Portal #6's quote list. Portal #8 admits quotes through its own registry: portal8.economics.
quote.approvedNote: Quotes this bundle vouches for, each confirmed by quoteApproved(address) when this was generated. The live set can hold more: Rebuild the live set from QuoteApproved and QuoteRevoked logs on the Portal from its deploy block: the constructor emitted QuoteApproved for the default, so the logs alone are complete.
quote.admission: A launch naming a quote that is not approved reverts QuoteNotApproved, whoever calls.
quote.approve: approveQuote(address), admin only. INSTANT: no queue and no timelock. Emits QuoteApproved(quote).
quote.revoke: revokeQuote(address), admin only, instant. Emits QuoteRevoked(quote). Refuses the default quote with DefaultQuoteNotRevocable. Reaches FUTURE launches only: a launched token keeps its quote and its pool forever.
quote.units: startFdvUsdc6, bondFdvUsdc6 and devBuyQuote are raw units of the launch's own quote. The Portal never rescales them, so under an 18-decimal quote they are 18-decimal amounts despite the Usdc6 names.

launching.legacyNote: Portal #6's launch call, kept so readers of version 3 keep working. Do not launch with it: every new launch goes to Portal #8, portal8.launching.
launching.devBuy: devBuyQuote, in the launch's quote's own units, is pulled from msg.sender with safeTransferFrom inside launch(). Approve the PORTAL for at least devBuyQuote on the quote token first. The pull must deliver exactly devBuyQuote or the launch reverts FeeOnTransferQuote. Whatever the swap does not spend below the 4x price ceiling is refunded in the same transaction. Zero means no dev buy and needs no approval.
launching.oneConfirmation: The Argus site sends the approve and the launch as one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls batch where the wallet supports it, and as two transactions where it does not. The launch itself is one transaction either way, so no block has the pool without the dev buy.

payouts.legacyNote: How Portal #6 and #5 tokens pay out, which stays true for them. Portal #8: portal8.payouts.
payouts.creator: CREDITED, NOT PUSHED. distribute() credits the creator's share to claimableQuote6(creator) on the launch's splitter (index 5 of the record) and emits Accrued(creator, quote, amount). It is delivered by claim(address account): permissionless, anyone may call it, and it always pays account, never the caller. The creator claims it from the token page. The Argus keeper does NOT claim it for them: it collects fees, cranks the split, funds dividends and pays holders, and leaves the creator's share credited.
payouts.treasury: Pushed inside distribute() as Paid(treasury, quote, amount). A failed push parks as PayFailed and is withdrawn with claim(treasury).
payouts.claimable: claimableQuote6(account) and claimableToken18(account) are what claim(account) would pay now, in the quote's own decimals and the token's 18.
payouts.asset: On Portal #6 claim() pays with an ERC-20 transfer of the launch's quote, so it shows as a Transfer log on that token. On Portal #5 it is a native USDC send, which Arc logs from the EIP-7708 pseudo-address 0xffff...fffe.

constants.legacyNote: Portal #6's numbers. Portal #8's differ, treasuryBps 3000 and MIN_TAX_BPS 100 among them: portal8.constants.
constants.treasuryAppliesTo: the tax AND the pool's own LP fees; the locker forwards both legs to the same splitter
constants.taxesAreImmutable: There is no reduceTaxes and no owner on this line. Rates are fixed at launch permanently.
constants.taxedEvents: trades only; wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed
constants.devBuyMaxBpsNote: 10000 disables the supply cap. What bounds the opening buy is DEV_BUY_MAX_TICK_MOVE.
constants.devBuyPriceCeiling: 4.00x of the opening price; oversized sends are PARTIALLY FILLED AND REFUNDED, not reverted
constants.timelockDelayNote: Pointer changes only. A one-way ratchet: it can be raised to maxTimelockDelaySeconds, never lowered. Quote approval does not wait on it.

portal7.note: LEGACY. Do not launch here: every new launch goes to Portal #8, launchPortal. Tokens already launched here keep working on chain. Deployed. The record is #6's eleven words; registry() tells the two apart. The payout asset is NOT in the record: read converts() on the splitter or payoutAsset() on the tracker.
portal7.discriminator: registry() answers on Portal #7 and reverts on Portal #6. LAUNCH_STRUCT_WORDS() answers 11 on BOTH and cannot separate them.
portal7.discriminatorNote: Portal #8 answers registry() too, and LAUNCH_STRUCT_WORDS() reverts on it. Select Portal #8 by address before applying this test.
portal7.expectConvert: The fourteenth launch field: 0 either, 1 must pay out in the QUOTE (the default quote or a keep-listed one), 2 must pay out in USDC (converted). A mismatch reverts PayoutAssetChanged(payout) before anything is deployed, and a value above 2 reverts ExpectConvertOutOfRange. A USDC launch takes 1, never 2.

ArgusV4Portal7.decodes: Launches on Portal #7. The SAME eleven-word record as Portal #6, and word 10 is still the pool's PAIRING quote - not the payout asset. Tell #7 from #6 by registry(), which answers on #7 and reverts on #6.

ArgusV4LaunchToken7.note: EIP-1167 clone target. Each launch has its own clone; this ABI describes every one.
ArgusV4LaunchToken7.decodes: Launches on Portal #7. quoteAsset() still answers the pairing; the payout asset is the tenth initialize argument and is readable from the tracker's payoutAsset().

ArgusV4HookedSplitter7.note: EIP-1167 clone target. Each launch has its own clone; this ABI describes every one.
ArgusV4HookedSplitter7.decodes: Launches on Portal #7. Adds converts(), a third claim bucket claimableUsdc6(address), and a claim(address) that returns THREE words - the selector is #6's, so a two-word decode still reads the first two.

portal8.note: Every new launch goes here. Portal #8 is the ArgusV5 line, live since 2026-09-22. It takes ONE params struct plus a mined hookSalt, requires an opening buy, allocates the fee across FIVE lanes and reads its starting and bond value from its own quote registry, so the call names no FDV. None of the older Portals' launch calls, selectors or salts work here.
portal8.deployBlockNote: The Portal's creation block. The whole deployment spans blocks 22,251,758 to 22,251,798; scanning from either finds every launch.

params: (string imageURI, string website, string twitter, string telegram, string description) meta
steps: 1. Pick a quote the registry admits: registry.admissionFor(quote) must answer admissible true and revoked false. See economics.
2. Size the opening buy: at least bondFdvQuote * minSeedPpm / 1,000,000 of the quote, in raw units. On USDC that is 4,500,000 raw, 4.50 USDC.
3. Mine hookSalt for the wallet that will SEND the launch. See hookSalt.
4. Approve the Portal on the quote token for the opening buy. The Portal pulls it with transferFrom inside launch().
5. Simulate launch(params, hookSalt) with eth_call from that wallet, then send it with your own gas limit. A launch uses about 8,000,000 gas; a wallet's fallback limit is too small.
6. Read the token from the call's return value or from Launched, topic 1.

fields.name: The token's name. Any string.
fields.totalSupply: 1e18 to 1e27 raw: 1 to 1,000,000,000 tokens at 18 decimals. Outside that, InvalidConfig. The whole supply goes into the pool.
fields.buyTaxBps: 100 to 1000 (1% to 10%). The hook's constructor refuses anything else (TaxTooLow, TaxTooHigh), and it runs under CREATE2, so the launch reverts HookMismatch(predicted, 0x0). Fixed forever.
fields.sellTaxBps: 100 to 1000 (1% to 10%), checked on its own exactly like buyTaxBps. Zero is refused like any value under 100.
fields.alloc: Five lanes in this order: creator, burn, dividends, liquidity, lock. They must total 10000 or InvalidConfig. They are shares of the fee left after the treasury's 30%, not extra fees.
fields.quoteAsset: The asset the pool pairs with. Must be sized on the registry (EconomicsMissing) and not revoked (QuoteAdmissionRevoked).
fields.payoutAsset: What the creator and holders are paid in: quoteAsset itself, or defaultQuoteAsset (USDC). Anything else, PayoutNotAllowed.
fields.kothBps: 0 disables the milestone. At most maxKothBps, else KothAboveCeiling. The Argus site sends 0.
fields.payoutAddress: Where the creator share pays. Zero means the sending wallet. Protocol addresses revert CreatorPayoutRefused.
fields.identityProvider: Zero, or bytes32 of a provider string read from identityEscrow: PROVIDER_GITHUB() or PROVIDER_X(). Both identity fields or neither.
fields.identitySubject: Zero, or the account's immutable numeric id, never a handle. With it, payoutAddress must equal identityEscrow.predict(provider, subject).
fields.bundle: The opening buy: at most one entry, { to, amountQuote }, totalling at least the floor or SeedBuyTooSmall. Tax-free, inside the launch transaction. It may not reach the bond (BundleCrossedTheBond).
fields.snipeExempt: Up to 25 wallets spared the 3 second opening surcharge. tx.origin values, so name a smart wallet's signer. Set once.
fields.meta: imageURI is stored on the token and read with logo(), at most 512 bytes. website, twitter, telegram and description are emitted in LaunchMetadata only.

launching.errors: launch() calls ArgusV5CreatorRegistry and ArgusV5IdentityEscrow, and their errors come back unchanged: decode a revert with their ABIs as well as the Portal's. The hook's constructor runs under CREATE2, so its refusals (a tax outside 100 to 1000, a salt mined for another wallet) arrive as HookMismatch(predicted, 0x0).

hookSalt.note: Nothing launches without a mined hookSalt. Uniswap v4 reads a hook's permissions from the low 14 bits of its address, and each launch deploys its own hook, so the salt has to put that hook on exactly the bits below.
hookSalt.flagBits: BEFORE_INITIALIZE 1<<13, BEFORE_SWAP 1<<7, AFTER_SWAP 1<<6, BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA 1<<3, AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA 1<<2. Not the older Portals' 0x2044.
hookSalt.creator: The wallet that SENDS launch(), msg.sender. Never payoutAddress. A salt mined for any other address puts the escrow somewhere the launch does not look, and it reverts HookMismatch.
derivation: template = portal.hookInitCodeTemplate(quoteAsset, buyTaxBps, sellTaxBps): the hook's full init code with the escrow word zeroed. Fetch once per creator, quote and tax pair.
escrow = last 20 bytes of keccak256(0xff, partsFactory, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(portal, escrowSalt)), escrowInitCodeHash)
Write escrow, left padded to 32 bytes, into template at byte offset template.length - 352 + 64: the third of eleven constructor words (poolManager, portal, escrow, ...).
hook = last 20 bytes of keccak256(0xff, hookFactory, hookSalt, keccak256(template)). The RAW hookSalt: only the escrow's salt is hashed.
hookSalt.crossCheck: Before sending, two eth_calls catch every derivation mistake: portal.predictEscrow(creator, hookSalt) must equal your escrow, and CREATE2(hookFactory, hookSalt, portal.hookInitCodeHash(creator, hookSalt, quoteAsset, buyTaxBps, sellTaxBps)) must equal your hook.
hookSalt.templateNote: The Portal's NatSpec for hookInitCodeTemplate said length - 320 + 64 until 2026-09-22. That lands on the treasury word and every salt mined from it fails. 352 is right: eleven constructor words.

economics.note: The registry fixes each quote's starting and bond value in that quote's own units: about $2,500 to start and $45,000 to bond, at the quote's price when the admin Safe sized it. Read registry.economicsFor(quote) for (startFdvQuote, bondFdvQuote, decimals). A launch keeps the figures it was created with. Reaching the bond marks the launch bonded on its hook; the pool does not move.
economics.admittedNote: Every quote the registry had sized when this file was generated, read from admissionFor. The admin Safe can admit, resize and revoke quotes at any time: read the registry before launching, never this list.

constants.minSeedFormula: floor = bondFdvQuote * minSeedPpm / 1,000,000, and never below 1 raw unit
constants.feeNote: Every buy and sell pays its side's tax plus the 1% base fee, taken in the quote by the hook. Wallet transfers are free.
constants.treasuryAppliesTo: the whole fee, base fee included. The five lanes split the rest.
constants.poolFee: 0x800000, the dynamic fee flag. Every swap overrides it to zero: the hook takes the whole fee in the quote.
constants.launchGas: about 8,000,000: 7,894,412 measured for a USDC launch at the floor opening buy

decoding.selectByAddress: Select Portal #8 by its ADDRESS. It answers registry(), the test portal7 uses to tell #7 from #6, and LAUNCH_STRUCT_WORDS() reverts on it. Never route a Portal #8 address through either discriminator.
decoding.launchesNote: Seven fields, a different record from every older Portal. No creator and no quote: the creator is Launched topic 2, the quote is hook.quoteAsset().
decoding.enumeration: launchCount() only. There is no tokenCount() or getTokens().
decoding.eventsNote: Launched replaces TokenCreated: its topic0 is neither of decoding.legacyTokenCreated's. LaunchMetadata carries the image and links in the same transaction.
decoding.poolKey: currency0 and currency1 are the token and its quote in address order, fee 0x800000, tickSpacing 200, hooks the launch's hook. Prefer hook.poolId() over rebuilding it.
decoding.swapLogs: Swap on the PoolManager, filtered by pool id, with the same swapper-side sign convention as decoding.swapLogs. The fee is taken by the hook in the quote and logged as QuoteFeeTaken on the hook.

payouts.creator: Credited in the launch's escrow. claimCreator() pays it; anyone may call it, and it always pays the payout address or its split.
payouts.dividends: Credited per holder on every trade. claimDividends() pays the caller; claimDividendsFor(holder) pushes to that holder, never to the caller.
payouts.payoutAsset: Fixed at launch: the launch's quote, or USDC through the converter.
payouts.treasury: 30% of every fee and the whole opening surcharge.

ArgusV5Portal.decodes: Launches on Portal #8. launch(params, hookSalt) creates them; launches(token) answers seven fields; Launched and LaunchMetadata announce them.

ArgusV5PartsFactory.decodes: Deploys each launch's token, escrow and locker. escrowInitCodeHash(portal) is a hook salt miner input.

ArgusV5HookFactory.decodes: Deploys each launch's hook by CREATE2 with the RAW hookSalt. Its address is the hook's CREATE2 deployer.

ArgusQuoteRouteRegistry.decodes: Portal #8's own registry, a different build from Portal #7's: admitted quotes and their economics. admissionFor(quote), economicsFor(quote), admissions(offset, limit).

ArgusV5CreatorRegistry.decodes: Who a launch's creator share pays: payoutOf(token), payoutSplit(token), rotation and takeovers. Its errors can revert a launch.

ArgusV5IdentityEscrow.decodes: Creator fees directed to a GitHub or X account. predict(provider, subject) is the payoutAddress such a launch must name.

ArgusV5TaxHook.note: One deployment per launch. The address here is one live example, the NOFEE launch; read yours from launches(token) or Launched.
ArgusV5TaxHook.decodes: The launch's fee machine and bonding latch. Read buyTaxBps(), sellTaxBps(), totalFeeBps(), bonded(), quoteAsset(), poolId().

ArgusV5RewardedToken.note: One deployment per launch. The address here is one live example, the NOFEE launch; read yours from launches(token) or Launched.
ArgusV5RewardedToken.decodes: The launch token. logo() answers the image link stored at launch.

ArgusV5PayoutEscrow.note: One deployment per launch. The address here is one live example, the NOFEE launch; read yours from launches(token) or Launched.
ArgusV5PayoutEscrow.decodes: Credits the creator share and holder dividends. claimCreator(), claimDividends(), claimDividendsFor(holder).

ArgusV5Locker.note: One deployment per launch. The address here is one live example, the NOFEE launch; read yours from launches(token) or Launched.
ArgusV5Locker.decodes: Holds the launch's liquidity position. It has no withdraw path.

ArgusV4Portal6.decodes: Launches on Portal #6 0xa5628a11c412596e1f63b75a2c0284f843c549d6. Portal #4 and #5 launches: ArgusV4HookedPortal.
